# David Santiago Vargas (krespokiller)

> Tech Lead specialized in fintech payment platforms and multi-tenant systems for Latin American markets. Leads teams of 5-6 engineers building event-driven architecture and cloud infrastructure with TypeScript, Python, NestJS, React, PostgreSQL, and AWS.

This site is a single-page 3D portfolio (React, TypeScript, three.js). Content sections:

## Selected Work (#work)
Three case studies:
- **Loopay Suite** — multi-tenant, cloud-native fintech payments platform for Latin American markets; led a team of 5 engineers; 60% faster deploys (15 to 6 minutes) via the SOBERANA deploy monorepo (Terraform, AWS, GitHub Actions).
  - https://soberana.loopay.com/
- **Galgo** — motorcycle e-commerce with embedded financing in Colombia; event-driven microservices processing 1,000+ leads per day.
  - https://www.galgo.com/co
- **Trebet** — mobile super-app for residential communities (payments, digital intercom, bookings, assembly voting); co-founded and led a team of 6 engineers; MVP to production in 1 month.
  - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.trebet&hl=es_CO
  - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/trebet/id6748287035
